title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
tagline: Build the future of business payments with Kairo.
intro: Join Kairo as a **Business Developer (BD)** and help businesses across Nigeria discover a smarter way to manage payments, sales and everyday business operations.
This is a field-driven role for people who are ambitious, persuasive, energetic and motivated by results.
You won't just be selling a product.
You'll be helping businesses move their operations into the future.

sections.title: What you'll do
sections.intro: As a Business Developer, you will:
items: Identify and prospect new businesses within your assigned territory.
Introduce businesses to Kairo and demonstrate how the platform works.
Onboard new businesses onto the platform.
Convert onboarded businesses into active Kairo users.
Build strong relationships with business owners and decision-makers.
Follow up with prospects and existing customers.
Drive referrals and new business opportunities.
Maintain accurate records of your activities and performance.
Work closely with your Business Development Manager to achieve team goals.

sections.title: What we're looking for
items: Have a minimum of **OND** from a recognized institution.
Be confident communicating with business owners and customers.
Be comfortable working in the field and meeting new people.
Have strong persuasion and negotiation skills.
Be target-driven and self-motivated.
Be willing to learn and grow.
Have basic digital literacy.
Have previous sales, business development, fintech or field marketing experience — **an advantage, but not mandatory.**

items.title: Competitive Base Pay
items.description: A reliable monthly base salary with additional earning opportunities.

items.title: Uncapped Commission
items.description: Your earning potential is not limited. The more qualified businesses you activate, the more you earn.

items.title: Performance Rewards
items.description: Your performance is measured regularly, with opportunities to earn additional incentives and recognition.

items.title: Career Growth
items.description: Top-performing Business Developers can progress into leadership roles within Kairo's distribution organization.

items.title: Training & Support
items.description: You'll receive the training, tools and support you need to succeed.

sections.title: How success is measured
sections.intro:
We care about more than just signing businesses up.
Your performance will be measured across:
items: Businesses onboarded
Businesses activated
Platform usage
Customer retention
Referrals
Overall sales performance
sections.closing: Don't just sign up businesses. Help them succeed on Kairo.

closing.title: Ready to build with us?
closing.body: If you're ambitious, hungry to grow and ready to build the future of business finance with us, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Business Development Manager (BDM)
tagline: Lead a team. Build a market. Grow with Kairo.
intro: Join Kairo as a **Business Development Manager (BDM)** and lead a team of Business Developers responsible for bringing businesses onto the Kairo platform.
This is a leadership role for ambitious sales professionals who can sell, coach, manage and build high-performing teams.
Your success isn't measured only by what you sell.
**It's measured by what your team can achieve.**

sections.title: What you'll do
sections.intro: As a Business Development Manager, you will:
items: Recruit, onboard and develop Business Developers.
Build and manage a high-performing sales team.
Set daily and weekly sales priorities.
Drive business acquisition within your assigned territory.
Personally prospect and close new businesses.
Coach BDs on prospecting, onboarding and activation.
Monitor team performance and identify areas for improvement.
Ensure businesses onboarded by your team become active users.
Drive referrals and customer growth.
Track team performance and submit regular reports.
Work closely with the State Manager and wider growth team.

sections.title: What we're looking for
items: Have a minimum of **OND** from a recognized institution.
Have proven sales, business development or team leadership experience.
Be confident managing and motivating a sales team.
Have strong communication and negotiation skills.
Be highly target-driven.
Be comfortable working in the field.
Be organized and disciplined.
Have strong problem-solving skills.
Have experience in fintech, payments, technology or FMCG sales — **an advantage, but not mandatory.**

items.title: Competitive Base Pay
items.description: A competitive monthly salary designed to reward leadership and performance.

items.title: Uncapped Commission
items.description: Earn from your personal performance and the performance of your team. The stronger your team performs, the more you earn.

items.title: Performance Incentives
items.description: Kairo operates a structured performance system that recognizes exceptional results.

items.title: Career Growth
items.description: Consistent high performance creates opportunities to progress into larger management and regional leadership roles.

items.title: Training & Leadership Development
items.description: You'll receive the tools, support and exposure required to become a stronger sales leader.

sections.title: How success is measured
sections.intro: BDM performance is measured across both personal and team performance:
items: Personal business activations
Team business activations
Businesses onboarded
Platform usage
Customer retention
Team productivity
Team development
Referrals
Leadership and execution

sections.title: Your growth path
sections.intro: A strong BDM can grow through Kairo's distribution organization into increasingly senior leadership positions.
items: **BD → BDM → State Manager → Regional Leadership**
sections.closing: Your growth is tied to **consistent performance, leadership and results.**

sections.title: The Kairo standard
sections.intro:
We don't want managers who simply manage numbers.
We want leaders who **build people, build businesses and build markets.**
sections.closing: Build a team. Build a market. Build your career.

closing.title: Ready to build with us?
closing.body: If you're ambitious, hungry to grow and ready to build the future of business finance with us, we'd love to hear from you.
